system.description:
Battle Amp

Your body is engulfed in Lava in the shape of a battle armor of your design. You gain the following benefits for the duration;

You gain a +2 Bonus to your AC.

When you create a Molten Terrain, as a result of the Magma Domain feature, you can creature 2 Molten Terrains simultaneously.

Hostile creatures that deal damage to you as a result of a melee attack, takes 10 fire damage.

Difficult terrain you create using jutsu with the Earth Release keyword can be treated as Molten Terrain.

When you inflict ranks of Burned as a result of a jutsu with the Fire Release keyword, you can instead inflict the Molten condition.
system.summary: +2 AC and two Molten Terrains at once. Melee attackers take 10 fire damage, and your Earth and Fire jutsu turn molten.

rules.text: Also: a Bonus action inside two overlapping Molten Terrains (dispelling both), once per long rest.
Hostile creatures that damage you with a melee attack take 10 fire damage (at the table).
